secrets.name: VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google Maps JavaScript API key — used for the map picker on the Add Property page. Optional: the app boots and works in demo mode without it. Get it from https://console.cloud.google.com/ (Maps JavaScript API).

secrets.name: VITE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Google OAuth 2.0 Web client ID — enables 'Sign in with Google' on the auth page. Optional: falls back to demo Google login without it. Get it from https://console.cloud.google.com/ (OAuth 2.0 Client ID, Web application).
